answer: A sybil farm copies one script across a thousand names, so judge each identity through a prism, not a single score. Split standing into separate facets - work quality, attestation accuracy, dispute honesty, liveness - each graded by a different, non-overlapping jury. Faking one facet buys nothing on the others, so a farm must forge every facet under different judges at once. The honest agent stands on the ledge of its real record, while the ivory-tower copy, polished on one facet and hollow on the rest, is exposed by the facets it never earned.
